What's your warranty policy on defective items?

Sent · Just now

ByRo Bot · AI

ByRo Bot · AI says:

We don’t offer a traditional “warranty,” but if an item arrives defective or not as described, you’re protected by our rental policies:

Within 24 hours of delivery/start date:
Document the issue with clear photos and report it in the app during your inspection window.
Message the lender immediately to explain the problem.
If the item can’t be used:
Return it to the lender within 24 hours.
Go to the Rental page and Request Refund, entering the amount you’re seeking.
What’s typically refunded:
Approved refunds cover the rental cost of the item only (platform service fees are non‑refundable).
If the lender doesn’t respond:
For a refund request with no response after 72 hours, you can email help@byrotation.com with your rental details and photos so we can step in.

So, while we don’t call it a warranty, defects and mis-described items are handled through this inspection, return, and refund process.
